lines.text: Your leads live in five places.
A text. A DM. A sticky note. An email you meant to answer.
Nobody knows who owns what, or what happens next.
So follow-ups slip, and good leads go cold.
We pull every inquiry into one board.
Every lead gets an owner, and a next action.
Your team always knows what to do next.
One place for every inquiry. Let's set yours up.
